description: ASTRA I-CATS builds tools that make complex space data understandable. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we created LUNA NAV: one intuitive console where mission planners, educators, and the public compare lunar landing sites, read Sun and Earth visibility, and see the terrain behind every decision. We pair scientific rigor with plain language, accessible design, and interactive visuals; turning SPICE ephemerides and LOLA terrain into a clear path from curiosity to a defensible decision.
